notes: I changed the rule: the shift applies only when the token's **last character** is alphabetic — trailing punctuation or spaces block it (E2's `"fizz!"`, `"end."`, `"  spaced  "` all unchanged, while `"a-b"`, `"one,two"`, `"cat's"` shift their final letter). The previous model searched for the last alphabetic char anywhere in the token, which wrongly shifted `"fizz!"`→`"fiza!"` and `"end."`→`"ene."`
